description: This file defines the TFAccessToken class, representing a two-factor authentication access token entity in a Java-based application. It includes fields for token value, associated user, validity period, and enabled status, along with methods for creating, validating, and converting tokens to data transfer objects.

classes.name: TFAccessToken
classes.description: Entity class representing a two-factor authentication access token with fields for token value, user association, validity period, and enabled status, including methods for token creation, validation, and data conversion.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a TFAccessToken with a specified token string, user, and token lifetime in seconds. Sets the validFrom to current tenant time and validTo accordingly.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks whether the token is currently valid based on its enabled status and whether the current tenant time falls within validFrom and validTo bounds.

methods.name: toTokenData
methods.description: Converts the TFAccessToken entity to an AccessTokenData DTO, including token string and validity period with timezone adjustments.
